info_description: 4Learn is a free app that makes learning and teaching simple. You can create your profile, explore helpful content, and join activities with other students and teachers. It’s designed to be easy for everyone to use, no matter your language or experience level.

about_description: do4learn is a cross-platform, 100% free educational platform designed to facilitate academic management, student participation, and results analysis. It is available both as a web version and an Android application, allowing flexible access from any device without subscription or licensing costs.
about_profile_item1: Registration via email or Gmail account: Users can create their profile using a traditional email address or authenticate directly with their Gmail account, ensuring fast and reliable access.
about_profile_item2: Personal data management: Each user can update their basic information (name and preferences) and keep their profile up to date.
about_profile_item3: Secure and cross-platform access: The profile synchronizes across both the web version and the Android app, ensuring continuity on any device.
about_crossplatform_item1: Web access: Available from any modern browser.
about_crossplatform_item2: Android application: Mobile access optimized for students and teachers.
about_activities_item1: Real-time feedback: Students can rate the course instantly through quick ratings, without the need for lengthy comments. This gives professors and managers immediate insight into course quality and allows timely adjustments.
about_activities_item2: Personalized learning profile: Each student defines their own learning profile for each course, based on best pedagogical practices. This profile helps identify learning styles, strengths, and areas for improvement, enabling more effective adaptation of content and methodologies.
about_activities_item3: Thesis review and tracking: The platform organizes and monitors the thesis development schedule, integrating the necessary activities for its progress. The entire process is based on academic best practices, ensuring structured, transparent, and real-time support.
about_ai_item1: Quick and simple assistance: The chatbot answers frequently asked questions about platform usage without the need to consult extensive manuals.
about_ai_item2: Role-based guidance: Responses are tailored to the user’s profile (manager, professor, or student), showing only the information relevant to their tasks.
about_ai_item3: Permanent availability: The chatbot is always active, both in the web version and the Android app, ensuring continuous support.
about_ai_item4: Friendly interaction: It provides clear and direct explanations, making navigation and use of the platform’s features easier.

thesis.template_description: Plan your thesis step by step
thesis.imageExportNotAvailable: Image export is not available on Web

action.choose_modality_desc: Decide which research modality best fits your interests, skills, and academic requirements.
action.choose_modality_ex: Ex: I have decided to choose the thesis modality...
action.set_space_time_desc: Define a quiet and suitable place to work and set weekly dedication time.
action.set_space_time_ex: Ex: I have an organized workspace and 15 hours per week...
action.define_schedule_desc: Create a work schedule that includes all stages of the research.
action.define_schedule_ex: Ex: I’ve established a schedule that divides my work into monthly phases...
action.learn_databases_desc: Get familiar with Scopus, ScienceDirect, Google Scholar and learn effective search techniques.
action.learn_databases_ex: Ex: I’ve learned to use Scopus to find academic articles...
action.review_sources_desc: Learn to identify and select relevant authors and literature efficiently.
action.review_sources_ex: Ex: I read the title, then abstract, and only if relevant I read the full article.
action.reference_tool_desc: Choose and learn to use Zotero, Mendeley, EndNote, etc.
action.reference_tool_ex: Ex: I’ve chosen Zotero to manage my references.
action.ethical_ai_desc: Be aware of the benefits, limitations, and ethical implications of using AI.
action.ethical_ai_ex: Ex: When using AI, I make sure to anonymize the data.
action.identify_journal_desc: Identify journals, requirements, and examples for publishing.
action.identify_journal_ex: Ex: I’ve identified two possible journals that address the topic...
action.backup_versioning_desc: Define a mechanism for regular backups and version control.
action.select_topic_desc: Choose a relevant and specific topic for research.
action.select_topic_ex: Ex: Impact of AI in education.
action.define_problem_desc: Clearly describe the problem to be investigated.
action.define_problem_ex: Ex: Lack of empirical evidence on how AI affects performance.
action.justify_problem_desc: Explain why the problem deserves to be studied.
action.justify_problem_ex: Ex: The research will help design educational policies.
action.research_question_desc: Formulate the central question that will guide the research.
action.research_question_ex: Ex: How does AI use influence academic performance?
action.review_background_desc: Review previous studies and relevant literature.
action.review_background_ex: Ex: I reviewed articles from the last 5 years on AI in education.
action.build_framework_desc: Build the theoretical framework that contextualizes the research.
action.build_framework_ex: Ex: Apply Constructivist Theory and TPACK model.
action.describe_methodology_desc: Describe the approach, design, and data collection techniques.
action.describe_methodology_ex: Ex: Mixed study: surveys and interviews.
action.design_collection_desc: Detailed plan for collection, participants, and techniques.
action.get_permissions_ex: Ex: University permission to apply surveys.
action.execute_collection_desc: Carry out the collection following protocols and schedule.
action.execute_collection_ex: Ex: Apply surveys in class for 2 weeks.
action.organize_data_desc: Systematically and securely record and organize data.
action.organize_data_ex: Ex: Save in spreadsheet and anonymous database.
action.verify_quality_desc: Check and clean errors and inconsistencies in the data.
action.verify_quality_ex: Ex: I corrected missing and duplicate values.
action.apply_tests_desc: Apply statistical tests or qualitative analysis.
action.apply_tests_ex: Ex: t-test, correlation, and multiple regression.
action.interpret_results_desc: Interpret results in relation to the question and hypothesis.
action.interpret_results_ex: Ex: Relate coefficients to proposed hypotheses.
action.write_intro_desc: Write the introduction contextualizing the research.
action.write_intro_ex: Ex: Context, problem, objectives, and structure.
action.write_body_desc: Develop chapters with results and discussion.
action.write_body_ex: Ex: Chapter 1: Theoretical framework; Chapter 2: Methodology...
action.write_references_desc: Complete the bibliography with relevant sources.
action.write_references_ex: Ex: APA format or the one required by the institution.
action.general_review_desc: Review the entire work to ensure coherence and completeness.
action.general_review_ex: Ex: I reviewed the entire thesis to ensure it is complete.
action.prepare_presentation_desc: Design the presentation and visual materials for the defense.
action.prepare_presentation_ex: Ex: Slides with key points and graphics.
action.practice_defense_desc: Rehearse the presentation and receive feedback.
action.practice_defense_ex: Ex: I simulated the defense with peers and adjusted the content.
action.review_evaluation_ex: Ex: I reviewed the rubric and adjusted the final document.
action.submit_thesis_desc: Submit the final document in the required format.
action.submit_thesis_ex: Ex: I uploaded the PDF to the institutional platform.
action.define_objectives_desc: Formulate clear and achievable objectives aligned with the research question.
action.define_objectives_ex: Ex: Analyze how students perceive AI in the classroom using surveys.
action.coverage_problem_justification_question_: Ensure coverage of problem, justification, question, and objectives
Review that all key elements of the research design are properly addressed.
Ex: I verified that my problem statement, justification, and objectives are clearly defined.
action.coverage_background_desc: Review the number and depth of referenced background sources.
action.coverage_background_ex: Ex: I included 10 pages of background literature from recent studies.
action.reference_50_desc: Gather at least 50 academic sources relevant to the research topic.
action.reference_50_ex: Ex: I compiled 55 articles and books related to AI in education.
action.methodology_approach_desc: Select a methodology that aligns with the research objectives and data type.
action.methodology_approach_ex: Ex: I chose a mixed-methods approach combining surveys and interviews.
action.methodology_procedure_desc: Detail the methods, tools, and participant selection for data collection.
action.methodology_procedure_ex: Ex: I will use random sampling and structured interviews.
action.methodology_ethics_desc: Ensure informed consent, confidentiality, and ethical treatment of participants.
action.methodology_ethics_ex: Ex: All participants signed consent forms and data is anonymized.
action.methodology_wow_desc: Identify unique or impactful aspects of your methodological approach.
action.methodology_wow_ex: Ex: I use AI to analyze learning patterns in real time.
action.results_communication_desc: Plan how results will be presented and where they will be published.
action.results_communication_ex: Ex: I will submit to a Q3 journal and present at a conference.
action.timeline_budget_desc: Outline project activities and budget using institutional formats.
action.timeline_budget_ex: Ex: I completed the university’s budget form and detailed each activity.
action.analysis_software_desc: Select software tools suitable for qualitative or quantitative data analysis.
action.analysis_software_ex: Ex: I used NVivo for interviews and SPSS for survey data.
action.analyze_limitations_desc: Identify and explain limitations such as sample size or data bias.
action.analyze_limitations_ex: Ex: The sample is limited to one university, which may affect generalizability.
action.follow_format_desc: Ensure the document follows institutional formatting and citation guidelines.
action.follow_format_ex: Ex: I used IEEE format and followed the thesis template.
action.academic_style_desc: Write clearly and formally, using proper citations and structure.
action.academic_style_ex: Ex: I revised my writing to remove informal phrases and ensure clarity.
action.complete_bibliography_desc: Include all relevant sources cited throughout the thesis.
action.complete_bibliography_ex: Ex: I updated my references with recent articles from 2023.
action.check_grammar_desc: Ensure the thesis is free of grammatical and spelling errors.
action.check_grammar_ex: Ex: I corrected verb agreement and punctuation issues in the introduction.
action.meet_objectives_conclusions_desc: Ensure the research meets its goals and conclusions reflect findings.
action.meet_objectives_conclusions_ex: Ex: My conclusions confirm the hypothesis and answer the research question.
